label: Research pool deep dive D (24 Oct 2026)

payload.writeUp: Deep dive D of 24 October 2026: a fresh look at 21 UK companies already in the pool, re-checking from their own sites, Companies House, platform listings and the press whether each is genuinely raising now, closed, or unknown. Access status found: 7 closed, 2 contactable, 1 expected, 5 fundraising reported, 3 unknown, 3 verified open. Closed raises are kept so the watch list and timeline stay honest; nothing here is presented as open without a source.

candidate.name: Magnitude Biosciences
candidate.teaser: Durham University spinout CRO screening compounds in C. elegans worms; £1.3m round led by Northstar closed Sep 2026.
candidate.description: Magnitude Biosciences is a Durham University spinout contract research organisation based at NETPark, Sedgefield. Its VivoScan platform screens compounds in whole C. elegans organisms using imaging, machine learning and robotics, with assays in ageing, gut, mitochondrial, muscle and cognitive health, offered from $1 per compound. It closed a £1.3m round in September 2026 led by Northstar Ventures (North East Spinout Inspire Fund, North East Innovation Fund, Northstar EIS Growth Fund) with Maven regional funds and new angels, unlocking a £217,000 Innovate UK Investor Partnership grant; this followed over £700,000 raised in May 2025. Team: CEO Dr Fozia Saleem, CTO and co-founder Dr Chris Saunter, co-founder Prof David Weinkove. Main risks: service revenue scale is undisclosed and the round that was open has just closed.
